name: varzea
description: Várzea — plataforma de gestão de futebol amador (painel web + PELA-BOT/VarzIA)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
